component.name: GT7 Datalogger
component.summary: Record and analyse Gran Turismo 7 telemetry

description.p: GT7 Datalogger records the telemetry your PlayStation sends while you drive Gran Turismo 7 and shows it in your browser: a live dash, lap and sector times, and lap-by-lap analysis. A phone or tablet on the same network can open the dash too.
It runs on your own computer and keeps your recordings there. GT7 Datalogger is unofficial and not affiliated with Sony Interactive Entertainment or Polyphony Digital.
